subject: Quick SEO win for John The Plumber
body:
Hi John The Plumber team,

I was reviewing John The Plumber's website and noticed 4 SEO issues that are likely costing you traffic:

1. Title too long (117 chars, may be truncated in SERP)
2. Meta description too long (167 chars)
3. Very slow server response (5.3s)

Small fixes like these often lead to big ranking improvements.

Want a free 5-minute video audit showing exactly what's hurting your rankings?

Cheers,
Sheikh from Rank Ray
